_comment: Single source of truth for MCP servers approved for this repo. Edit this file, then run `make gen-mcp`. Changes need security review (see CODEOWNERS). Rules, enforced by tools/gen_mcp_configs.py: pin every package and image to an exact version, list the environment variables a server needs by name only, never put a secret value here.

github.description: Read issues, pull requests and code in our GitHub org. Read-only mode, limited toolsets.
github.permissions: Read-only tools only (GITHUB_READ_ONLY=1). Use a fine-grained token with read-only access to this org's repos.

filesystem-docs.permissions: docs/ folder only. --read-only withholds every write tool; --confine-roots stops clients widening the folder.
